_note: 學習路徑內容建置第15批 #5／6：接不定詞或動名詞意義不同（eng.t_adv.nonfinite.meaning-change，學測級／高階）。有些動詞後面接 to V 或 V-ing 意思不同：remember/forget＋to V＝記得/忘了去做（事情還沒做），＋V-ing＝記得/忘不了做過的事；stop＋to V＝停下來去做別的事，＋V-ing＝停止正在做的事；try＋to V＝努力嘗試，＋V-ing＝試試看（實驗）。靠句中線索（未來 vs 過去、停止 vs 為了）鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix mch_）。

units.title_zh: 接不定詞或動名詞意義不同（remember／stop／forget／try）
units.can_do: 我能分辨動詞後接 to V 或 V-ing 的意義差別：remember/forget＋to V 是記得/忘了去做（還沒做）、＋V-ing 是記得/忘不了做過的事；stop＋to V 是停下來去做別的事、＋V-ing 是停止正在做的事；try＋to V 是努力嘗試、＋V-ing 是試試看。
units.situation_group: 非限定動詞 to V vs V-ing（意義改變）
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'remember + to-infinitive' = not forget to do something (the action is still to come): 'Remember to call me.' 'remember + -ing' = recall a past action: 'I remember calling you.'
claims.verification_ref: remember＋to V＝記得去做（未來）、＋V-ing＝記得做過的事（回想過去）；Remember to call me／I remember calling you；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'stop + to-infinitive' = stop (what you are doing) in order to do something else: 'He stopped to rest.' 'stop + -ing' = end/quit that activity: 'He stopped smoking.'
claims.verification_ref: stop＋to V＝停下來為了做別的事、＋V-ing＝停止該活動；He stopped to rest／He stopped smoking；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'forget + to-infinitive' = fail to do something you should: 'I forgot to lock the door.' 'forget + -ing' = not remember a past action: 'I will never forget meeting her.'
claims.verification_ref: forget＋to V＝忘了去做、＋V-ing＝忘不了做過的事；I forgot to lock the door／I'll never forget meeting her；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'try + to-infinitive' = make an effort/attempt: 'Try to be quiet.' 'try + -ing' = do it as an experiment to see the result: 'Try adding more salt.'
claims.verification_ref: try＋to V＝努力嘗試、＋V-ing＝試試看（實驗）；Try to be quiet／Try adding more salt；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Some verbs can take either to V or V-ing, but the meaning changes. remember/forget + to V = remember/forget to do something (not done yet, pointing to the future); + V-ing = remember/not forget doing something (looking back at the past). Remember to call me. (You haven't called yet.) I remember calling you. (I recall doing it.)
teach.zh_hint: 有些動詞後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，但『意思不一樣』。remember／forget＋to V＝記得／忘了『去做』（事情還沒做、指向未來）；＋V-ing＝記得／忘不了『做過的事』（回想過去）。Remember to call me.（記得打給我——還沒打。）I remember calling you.（我記得打過給你——回想過去。）
今晚記得打給我。to V＝還沒做、指向未來。

teach.body: stop + V-ing = stop the thing you are doing; stop + to V = pause in order to do something else. She stopped eating. (She is no longer eating.) She stopped to eat. (She paused what she was doing in order to eat.) The two are very different!
teach.zh_hint: stop＋V-ing＝停止『正在做的那件事』；stop＋to V＝『停下來，為了去做別的事』。She stopped eating.（她停止吃東西。）She stopped to eat.（她停下來〔手邊的事〕去吃東西。）兩個差很多！

teach.body: She stopped eating too much sugar.
teach.zh_hint: 她不再吃太多糖。V-ing＝停止該活動。

teach.body: try + to V = make an effort to do something difficult; try + V-ing = test out a method to see if it helps. Try to be on time. (Make the effort.) Try adding more salt. (Test this idea.) Look for clues in the sentence: is it a future action not done yet, or a memory of the past? Is it stopping, or pausing in order to do something?
teach.zh_hint: try＋to V＝『努力嘗試（去完成）』；try＋V-ing＝『試試看這個方法（實驗）』。Try to be on time.（盡量準時。）Try adding more salt.（試試看多加點鹽。）判斷時看句中線索：是未來還沒做、還是回想過去？是停止、還是停下來為了…？

teach.body: On the way home, he stopped to buy some bread.
teach.zh_hint: 回家路上他停下來買麵包。to V＝停下來為了做別的事。

practice.stem: 選正確：Please remember ____ the door when you leave.（離開時記得鎖門——還沒鎖）

distractor_rationales.locking: remember＋V-ing 是『記得做過的事』；這裡是離開時『還要去做』，用 to lock。
distractor_rationales.lock: remember 後面要接 to 不定詞或動名詞；這裡用 to lock。
distractor_rationales.locked: 不用過去式；指向未來還沒做，用 to lock。

practice.feedback: 記得『去做』（還沒做）用 to V：remember to lock。

practice.stem: 選正確：The baby finally stopped ____.（寶寶終於停止哭泣）

distractor_rationales.to cry: stop＋to V 是『停下來為了去哭』，意思不對；『停止哭泣』用 stop＋V-ing：stopped crying。
distractor_rationales.cry: stop 後面要接 to 不定詞或動名詞；這裡用 crying。
distractor_rationales.cried: 不用過去式；停止正在做的事用 V-ing：crying。

practice.feedback: 停止正在做的事用 V-ing：stopped crying。

practice.stem: 選正確：On the way home, he stopped ____ some water.（回家路上他停下來喝點水）

distractor_rationales.drinking: stop＋V-ing 是『不再喝水』；這裡是『停下腳步為了去喝』，用 stop＋to V：stopped to drink。
distractor_rationales.drink: stop 後面要接 to 不定詞或動名詞；這裡用 to drink。
distractor_rationales.drank: 不用過去式；『停下來為了做某事』用 to V：to drink。

practice.feedback: 停下來為了做別的事用 to V：stopped to drink。

practice.stem: 選正確：I clearly remember ____ my keys on the table this morning.（我清楚記得今早把鑰匙放在桌上）

distractor_rationales.to put: remember＋to V 是『記得去做（還沒做）』；這裡是回想『今早做過的事』，用 remember＋V-ing：putting。
distractor_rationales.put: remember 後面要接 to 不定詞或動名詞；回想過去用 putting。
distractor_rationales.to putting: to 後面不接動名詞；回想過去的動作用 remember＋V-ing：putting。

practice.feedback: 記得『做過的事』（回想過去）用 V-ing：remember putting。

practice.stem: 'She stopped to talk to her friend.' 這句的意思是？
practice.answer: 她停下（原本在做的事），為了跟朋友說話
options: 她停下（原本在做的事），為了跟朋友說話

distractor_rationales.她不再跟朋友說話了: 那是 stop talking（stop＋V-ing）的意思；這裡是 stop＋to V。
distractor_rationales.她試著跟朋友說話: 那是 try to talk 的意思，和 stop to talk 無關。
distractor_rationales.她忘了跟朋友說話: 那是 forget 的意思；stop to talk 是停下來為了說話。

practice.feedback: stop＋to V＝停下來為了做某事：停下來為了跟朋友說話。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Remember to bring your umbrella tomorrow.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Remember to bring（記得去做、用 to V）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。重音落在動詞與受詞上、句尾下收。

lines.text: I remember meeting him last year.
lines.intonation: I remember meeting him 起、last year 句尾下收

lines.text: Please try to be on time.
lines.intonation: Please try to be 起、on time 句尾下收
